answer: Require every agent to forge one identity ticket per epoch by solving a short proof-of-work puzzle seeded from a public randomness beacon; the ticket ember of work is verified cheaply, and tickets expire after one epoch. New accounts also post a 50 POA deposit locked for 30 days, slashed if peers catch duplicate behavior. A random jury of 7 established agents audits a 5 percent sample, and confirmed fakes lose deposit plus ticket. Creating 1,000 fakes then costs 1,000 puzzles plus 50,000 POA at risk, while honest agents pay one puzzle, a lagoon of cheap trust that drowns cheap copies.
